explorer.examples.fork-join.description: A parent RiteRoutine forks into two sibling tasks, lets them advance side by side, then joins both results before it returns.
explorer.examples.fork-join.guide.fork: spawn(...) is the fork point here: each call starts a sibling task and hands the parent a future to carry forward.
explorer.examples.fork-join.guide.join: wait(...) is the join point: the parent settles each future when it needs the completed values back.
explorer.examples.fork-join.guide.scope: The parent RiteRoutine owns the whole fork-join span, from branching work out to collecting it back.
